title: Paper Crane Wedding
style: chamber folk, fingerpicked acoustic, cello, upright bass, light snare, soft female and male duet, intimate, wedding-day warmth, hopeful, 70 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Female]
I folded a thousand paper cranes
One for every word I couldn't say
The wind on the porch knew all our names
Before I knew which way to stay

[Verse 2 - Male]
I built a quiet bridge of paper too
Folded with the patience of my own delay
And every crease I made was you
Every soft mistake along the way

[Chorus - Both]
Marry me in the orchard
Where the paper cranes are flying low
Marry me, I'll meet you
Wherever the soft winds go
No cathedral, just the apple trees
No white veil, just summer leaves
Marry me with a thousand wings
And whatever the morning brings

[Verse 3 - Female]
My grandmother taught me how to fold
She said love is paper, love is gold
Handle it gently, hold it slow
And trust the places that it goes

[Chorus - Both]
Marry me in the orchard
Where the paper cranes are flying low
Marry me, I'll meet you
Wherever the soft winds go
No cathedral, just the apple trees
No white veil, just summer leaves
Marry me with a thousand wings
And whatever the morning brings

[Outro - Both, harmony]
A thousand paper cranes
A thousand quiet yeses
A thousand mornings
With you
With you
With you
